author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: प्रतिज्ञातज्ञानप्रदर्शनाय मयेत्यादिना हरेर्व्याप्तत्वसर्वाधारत्वाद्युक्त्वा न चेत्यादि श्लोकद्वयेन तदुपपाद्याधुना पुनः प्रतिज्ञातज्ञानप्रदर्शनार्थं प्रलयादिकारणत्वमाह ॥ सर्वेति। कल्पक्षये प्रलयकाले सर्वाणि भूतानि सजडजीवजातानि मामिकां मदधीनां त्रिगुणात्मिकां प्रकृतिं यांति तत्र लीयंते । पुनस्तानि भूतानि कल्पादौ विशेषेण विविधतया चाहं सृजामि ॥ ९.७॥
translation: During dissolution, all beings, Kaunteya, go into Prakriti who is Mine; at the beginning of Kalpa, I again bring them out in various forms. (7) V. All beings: the multitudes of souls together with the non-intelligent things. Who is Mine: who is under My control and consists of the three qualities, Satya, Rajas, and Tamas. Kalpa: the period during which the effected things of the world remain in the gross state.A. In the context treating of creation (in the Vedas) Prakriti does not appear to be mentioned.
